ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

2. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Zakat? (1 mark)
   A. Say Administration of Zakat has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Administration of Zakat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Administration of Zakat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Administration of Zakat.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Care for widows? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for widows.
   B. Use Care for widows to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Care for widows has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Types of verses? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of verses.
   C. Use Types of verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Types of verses has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an.
   B. Use Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected verses Surah al- Furqan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Selected verses Surah al- Furqan has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses Surah al- Furqan.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Funeral Rites? (1 mark)
   A. Say Funeral Rites has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Funeral Rites to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Funeral Rites.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an.
   B. Say Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Asbabu al- nuzuul? (1 mark)
   A. Say Asbabu al- nuzuul has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Asbabu al- nuzuul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asbabu al- nuzuul.
   D. Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

11. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   D. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: Islamic clothing and adornment 3.3 Virtues: manners of walking 3.4 Virt and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: Islamic clothing and adornment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: manners of walking 3.4 Virtues: honesty 3.5 Prohibitions in Islam Page  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: manners of walking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Virtues: manners of walking; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
